findings.reason: The proposed diff changes the backfill to set amount_minor = amount_rub instead of amount_rub*100. This violates the CHECK constraint added in the same script (amount_minor % 100 = 0 AND amount_minor/100 = amount_rub) and the explicit backfill verification in the transition to state S1, which will raise a BACKFILL error and break the migration.
